title: VisionResultContract
description: Standardized output contract for the Jaldrishti computer vision inference pipeline (Krish). Supports relative/image-space measurements without premature physical scaling.

structure_type.description: Identified structural classification (e.g. baoli, bawari, kund, vav, tank, unknown)

scale_reference.description: Optional calibrated spatial reference if a physical marker or known dimension was detected.

detections.description: Visual defects, vegetative intrusion, and structural degradation segments detected in image-space.

class_name.description: Defect classification label (e.g. crack, vegetation_root_intrusion, spalling, efflorescence, biological_growth, stone_dislodgement)

confidence.description: Confidence score of the model detection

bounding_box.description: Image coordinates [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max] in pixels

segmentation_mask_reference.description: Relative URI or mask file identifier referencing RLE / binary mask array

pixel_area.description: Total defect pixel area in image space

coverage_ratio.description: Ratio of defect pixel area relative to total image / region area

component_count.description: Number of connected components identified for this defect group

total_length_pixels.description: Estimated skeletonized center-line length in pixel space

largest_component_length_pixels.description: Pixel length of the largest contiguous defect component

relative_severity.description: Relative visual severity based strictly on visual coverage and morphology
